title: 第一卷 第9章 到底傍上了谁第一卷 第10章 张娴雅你好狠的心
slug: 神女录从废丹房杂役开始
lines: 不出半盏茶功夫，长廊尽头传来一阵环珮叮当的脆响。
一名身披大红锦袍的少妇款款走来。
女人生得极美。
水蛇腰扭动间，高开叉的裙摆下露出一截晃眼的白腻长腿。
领口处峰峦起伏，呼之欲出。
但曹阳的注意力全然不在那艳丽的外表上。
这女人身上的气息极具压迫感，很可能是炼气巅峰的存在。
曹阳心中立刻警惕了起来。
难道这女人打算强留自己了？
少妇停在曹阳三步之外，嘴角噙着笑，一双杏眼上下打量着。
与此同时，曹阳也感受到了那目光中带来的异样，就好像有种东西在自己身上流转了一圈，想要看穿他的底细。
曹阳面色不变，静静地站在那里。
少妇却是越看，表情越严肃。
她这门探查秘法屡试不爽，连寻常筑基修士都能看出些许端倪。
可碰到眼前这黑袍人，竟没有泛起半点波澜。
此人绝非池中物！
少妇迅速变脸，展颜一笑，水蛇腰一扭便凑了上来，带起一阵醉人的香风。
“这位道友请了。”
“妾身红袖，添为这掌生阁管事。”
红袖声音娇媚，从袖中摸出一个锦袋，双手递到曹阳面前。
“底下这瞎了眼的老狗不懂规矩，冒犯了道友，妾身代她赔个不是。”
曹阳没有伸手，只是冷冷看着她。
红袖笑容更加妩媚，“这里头是一百一十块下品灵石，算是退还道友刚才的入场费和房间费，九灵姑娘在被扣押期间，道友放一万个心，以后您再来，一切费用全免，就当妾身交您这个朋友。”
这下倒是让曹阳有些惊讶了。
没想到这少妇这么会办事？
那他也没有必要继续拿着架子了。
曹阳心里也很清楚，真要把这炼气巅峰的管事逼急了，自己的真实实力可不够看。
他冷哼一声，伸手接过锦袋，颠了颠。
“掌生阁还算有个懂规矩的。”
说罢，曹阳拂袖越过红袖，大步向外走去。
红袖看着曹阳离去的背影，眼底闪过一丝忌惮。
这份气度，这等深不可测的底蕴，绝对不是简单人物。
幸好自己反应快，没把人得罪死。
走出掌生阁后院大门，曹阳拐进一条无人的暗巷，背靠着墙壁，长长吐出一口浊气。
后背的衣服早已被冷汗浸透。
content_en:
Not even half a cup of tea later, there was a crisp sound of jingle rings coming from the end of the corridor.
A young woman wearing a bright red brocade robe walked up.
Women are born extremely beautiful.
As the water snake's waist twisted, a dazzling white long leg was exposed under the high-slit skirt.
The neckline has undulating peaks, ready to be breathed out.
But Cao Yang's attention was not at all on that gorgeous appearance.
The aura on this woman's body was extremely oppressive, and she was probably at the peak of Qi refining.
Cao Yang immediately became alert.
Could this woman be planning to keep him by force?
The young woman stopped three steps away from Cao Yang, with a smile on her lips and a pair of almond eyes looking up and down.
At the same time, Cao Yang also felt something strange in that gaze, as if something was circulating around him, wanting to see through his true identity.
Cao Yang's expression remained unchanged and he stood there quietly.
The more the young woman looked, the more serious her expression became.
Her method of detecting secrets has been tried and tested repeatedly, and even ordinary foundation-building monks can see some clues.
But when he met the man in black robes in front of him, he didn't feel the slightest reaction.
This person is definitely not a creature in the pool!
The young woman changed her face quickly, smiled, and the water snake came forward with a twist of its waist, bringing with it an intoxicating fragrance.
"This fellow Taoist has invited me."
"I have red sleeves, and Tian is the steward of Zhangsheng Pavilion."
Hong Xiu had a charming voice, took out a brocade bag from her sleeve, and handed it to Cao Yang with both hands.
"This blind old dog down there doesn't understand the rules and has offended fellow Taoist. I will make amends on her behalf."
Cao Yang didn't reach out and just looked at her coldly.
Hongxiu's smile became even more charming, "Here are one hundred and ten low-grade spirit stones, which can be regarded as a refund for fellow Taoist's entrance fee and room fee. While Miss Jiuling is being detained, fellow Taoist, I can rest assured that if you come back in the future, all fees will be free of charge. I will treat you as my concubine and be your friend."
This time, Cao Yang was a little surprised.
Didn’t expect this young woman to be so good at doing things?
Then there is no need for him to continue holding the shelf.
Cao Yang also knew very well that if he really wanted to push this steward at the peak of Qi refining, his true strength would not be enough.
He snorted coldly, reached out to take the brocade bag, and shook it.
"There is someone in Zhangsheng Pavilion who understands the rules."
After that, Cao Yang flicked his sleeves and crossed the red sleeves, striding out.
Hongxiu looked at Cao Yang's leaving figure, a trace of fear flashed in her eyes.
With this magnanimity and such unfathomable depth, he is definitely not a simple person.
Fortunately, I reacted quickly and didn't offend anyone to death.
After walking out of the gate of the backyard of Zhangsheng Pavilion, Cao Yang turned into a deserted dark alley, leaned his back against the wall, and let out a long breath.
The clothes on my back were already soaked with cold sweat.
